ModMetaData.name: Readable Fonts 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Local
ModMetaData.description: Replaces RimWorld 1.7 UI fonts with an installed Windows font. Defaults to Malgun Gothic Bold. Includes an automatically populated font list, name search, a filter for the current game language, TTF/OTF/TTC/OTC support, and original-font restoration. The language filter updates when the game language changes. Uses Waylith font registration. Font files are not bundled.
